sources.title: Creating a New Persian Poet Based on Machine Learning
sources.snippet: In this article we describe an application of Machine Learning (ML) and Linguistic Modeling to generate persian poems. In fact we teach machine by reading and learning persian poems to generate fake poems in the same style of the original poems.
